title: knight shift
pitch: you are one knight in a hard hat. everyone else is management. land in an L, take their stuff, don't stand on red.
controls: tap or click a green dot to jump there. keyboard: arrows pick a move, enter jumps, 1-9 jump straight to a numbered move, d toggles danger tint, b/c use abilities, m or esc opens the menu (daily shift lives there), p pauses.
how_to: you are the knight: tap a green dot to jump in an L. land on a piece to take it.
red squares are where management hits back. landing on one costs a heart.
take half the pieces (or outlast the shift clock) to open the stairs. take everyone for a bigger bonus.
every 5th floor is a boss with a pattern. pick a perk after each floor; the vending machine opens every 3rd.
